senses.gloss: चिवुक चिवुक, n. The chin, Yājñ. 3, 98.

† चीव् चीव्, or चीब्, or चीय्, i. 1, Par., Ātm.
 1. To take.
 2. To cover. चीव्, i. 10, Par. To shine (or speak).
चीवर चीवर (perhaps from 1. चि by the affixes वन् + अ), n. The tattered dress of a Buddhist mendicant, MBh. 1, 3638; or of any mendicant, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 15.
